description.value: Kinton Ramen at Gilmore Place is a Japanese ramen chain restaurant inside the Gilmore Place shopping centre in Burnaby, steps from Gilmore SkyTrain Station. Part of one of the largest ramen chains in North America with 50+ locations across Canada and the US, it serves fully customizable bowls with a choice of pork, beef, chicken, or vegetarian broth, multiple flavour profiles, and noodle types including shirataki. Touring cyclists will find a hearty, filling sit-down meal in a busy transit-oriented shopping hub.
